unresolvedConflicts.subject: Manager scope classification
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The supplied repository snapshot marks the requested manager as unknown (knownManager=false) while the supplied manager universe simultaneously includes Riverstone Holdings, creating a manifest-level inconsistency that prevents inclusion of any funds under the census rules.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Confirm whether Riverstone Holdings should be a recognized canonical manager in the fund-manager universe; if yes, update the manifest to knownManager=true before running fund-level census.
